title: Functions report input
description: Structured source evidence for the deterministic functions-outline renderer.

files.description: Defining source files. Paths must be unique after slash normalization.

path.description: Structural path containing all directory segments and the defining filename.

proposal.description: Marks a file that an explicit proposal would add or remove. The renderer shows a bright-green ADD or red REMOVE badge and changes only the directly enclosing folder's matching figure by one.

changes.description: Optional proposal addition and deletion figures not already represented by proposal-marked source-item rows. The renderer shows them on the defining file and its directly enclosing folder, not higher folder ancestors. Ordinary reports omit this and render zeroes. These figures do not alter the inventory-derived total count badge.

signature.description: Real source-level name and actual parameters, including empty parentheses when applicable.

proposal.description: Marks a callable that an explicit proposal would add or remove. The renderer shows a bright-green ADD or red REMOVE badge and changes only the defining file's matching figure by one.

returns.description: Material source-supported return type or result shape, without the arrow prefix.

description.description: Concise responsibility only when the signature is not self-explanatory.

uses.description: Architecturally important implicit dependency or side effect.

updates.description: Architecturally important state mutation or persistence effect.

constants.description: Named source constants rendered with the reserved pink system color.

dataStructures.description: Named enums, object or dictionary shapes, JSON-like declarations, and similar data structures rendered with the reserved dark-red system color.

signature.description: The real source-level declaration name or compact defining shape.

proposal.description: Marks a proposed addition or removal and changes only the defining file's matching figure by one.

description.description: Concise responsibility only when the declaration is not self-explanatory.
